title: SeaBatical Grayt 30A Vacations
description_expanded: AboutSeaBatical ~ 55 Gulf Shore Drive ~ Grayton Beach FL 32459 Need a last-minute stay? Please call our office at 844-941-1213 to make last-minute bookings via telephone, as availability within the next 7-nights will not show on calendar. We do not allow online bookings within 7-nights/one week of an arrival date. 20% Discount off Spring Break and Spring Rates! 4-night minimum with flexible arrival/departure days. Valid on new bookings only for stays completed prior to May 22nd. Discount is reflected in online pricing. SeaBatical is a family friendly, renovated 4 bedroom/ 4 bath home with private heated pool (heating fee applies) that sleeps up to 10. Offering a total of 4,522sf, it has stunning views of Grayton State Park dunes, Alligator Lake, the beach and the Gulf, and is located in the highly sought-after Gulf Trace neighborhood. Updated/refreshed every year, feel the care and love this amazing home offers...and want for nothing!! PLEASE NOTE - Golf carts and on-street parking are STRICTLY PROHIBITED in the Gulf Trace neighborhood, per neighborhood covenants. Fireplace in living room is decorative only and not for guest use. No local cable channels on any Smart TV's; streaming services available with guest account login. SeaBatical borders the Grayton Beach State Park, named America’s #1 Beach in 2020 by Dr. Stephen Leatherman, aka Dr. Beach! “This beach boasts of its sugar-white sand and emerald green water where development has been restrained so big sand dunes still dominate the landscape. At the same time, all the amenities of great restaurants and accommodations are close by in the old town of Grayton Beach or Seaside," wrote Leatherman. Originally named the country’s top beach in 1994, Grayton Beach State Park has been listed four times since 1991, finishing 6th in 2016 and 3rd in 2019. Guests can enjoy strolling along sugar sand beaches on a 20-minute walk east to downtown Grayton and area icons Red Bar and The Zoo Gallery. Founded in the mid-1880’s, historic Grayton Beach is South Walton’s original beach community and has stayed true to its funky, eclectic vibe. Seaside is 2.5 miles East where you can enjoy delectable delights along Air Stream Row, sunset cocktails overlooking the beach at Bud & Alley’s, a free outdoor concert or movie at the Seaside Amphitheater and shopping to your heart’s content! Ground level: 1 bedroom, 1 bath. #1 bedroom has two Bunk beds (Twin-over-double) Full bathroom, tub/shower. Please note the bunk room is only accessed via the exterior door with no interior access to the upper floor. Level One: Living room, dining, kitchen, laundry room, 1 bedroom, 1 bath, screened porch. Fireplace in living room is decorative only and not for guest use. #2 bedroom has king bed, private balcony. Full bath, tub/shower. Level Two: 2 bedrooms, 2 baths. #3 bedroom has 2 twin beds, private balcony. Full bathroom, tub/shower. #4 En-Suite Master bedroom, walk-in shower, private balcony. Amenities: Business Features: Hi Speed Wireless Internet (password secured) Entertainment Features 5 Smart TVs (sound bar in living room) with HDMI cable for games, 5 DVD Players, Board games, puzzles, card games, books, DVD movies. Please note - No local cable channels on any Smart TV's; streaming services available with guest account login. Distinctive Features: Private heated pool (heating fee applies) Expansive views of Grayton Beach State Park, Alligator Lake, beach, Gulf Private Gulf front neighborhood with 2 private beach accesses Bed, bath and kitchen linens provided Beach Gear Credit Please note - the pool heater at SeaBatical is an electric heater and will not operate should ambient temperatures fall below 55 degrees; therefore, we do not recommend adding pool heating to your stay in colder months. General Features: Carport parking for 2 vehicles Open gravel parking for 2 vehicles Please note - on street parking and golf carts are not allowed in the Gulf Trace neighborhood 2 King beds, 2 twin beds, 2 bunk beds (twin-over-double) 4 full bathrooms iron, ironing board, hair dryers, portable intercom (for ground floor bunkroom), bluetooth radio, gas grill w/grill utensils, 4 outdoor decks, deck furniture, screened porch, porch furniture, outdoor shower. Linens provided. No Smoking. No Pets. Kitchen Features: Fully equipped kitchen, coffee maker, electric range, refrigerator with ice maker, stand-alone ice maker, microwave, dishwasher, toaster, crock pot, blender, hand held mixer. Area Features: Timpoochee Trail (30A bike path) Downtown Grayton (1.4 mile) Seaside (2 miles) State Parks (Tops’l, Grayton Beach, Deer Lake)
